$comment: Resolution settings for the functions in this directory.
'imports' maps the two bare specifiers the app's own modules use. src/plugins/validate.ts
imports 'fflate' for the ZIP reader, and no Edge Function runtime has it otherwise.
'sloppy-imports' is what lets these functions import the app's own TypeScript sources:
every module under src/ imports its siblings without a file extension (Vite and tsc
both resolve that; Deno does not by default), and duplicating those files here to add
'.ts' would defeat the point of importing them at all. If the deployment's Deno version
does not honour this key, see docs/community-backend.md — the fallback is to vendor the
two modules at deploy time, not to re-implement them.
